# 🛡️ Entra ID Audit Logs — Identity Control-Plane & Attack Paths

**Purpose:** Hunt *who* changed the identity control plane, *what* they changed, *how consequential* it was, whether it forms part of an *attack path*, and *what to investigate next*. This is a control-plane hub built on `AuditLogs`, complementing (not duplicating) sign-in, non-interactive and workload-identity workbooks.

| Tab | What it covers |
|-----|----------------|
| � Overview | CISO security KPIs, top risks, break-glass monitor, control-plane change volume |
| 🚨 SOC Queue | Ranked, reason-bearing triage queue of high-impact changes |
| 👑 Privilege & PIM | Role/group assignments, eligibility, self-assignment, outside-PIM, SP-initiated |
| 🧩 Apps & SP | App/SP creation, credential adds, owners, lifecycle paths |
| 🎟️ Permissions | Delegated vs application permissions with a Low→Critical risk catalogue |
| 🔐 Auth & CA | Conditional Access & security-control degradation, federation, domain, tenant drift |
| 👥 Users & Groups | User lifecycle, SSPR vs admin resets, group/owner changes, user→group→privilege |
| 🧭 Attack Paths | Multi-stage chains toward privilege, persistence and control (MITRE ATT&CK) |
| 🔎 Investigation | Entity timeline, old/new values, correlation pivots |
| 📋 Governance | Privileged-identity, application and control governance (IdentityInfo) |
| 🎯 MITRE | Technique-centric ATT&CK coverage + use-case → hunt / rule map |
| ⚙️ Readiness | Data health, operation discovery, enrichment availability |

parameters.label: Queue Priority

parameters.name: Result
parameters.label: Result

parameters.description: AuditLogs Category. Multi-select to scope. Empty = all categories.

parameters.query: AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where isnotempty(LoggedByService) | distinct LoggedByService | order by LoggedByService asc | take 200

parameters.name: ExcludedActors
parameters.label: Excluded Actors
parameters.description: Comma-separated actor UPNs / app display names to drop from every tile (e.g. noisy sync or automation accounts). Empty = no exclusion.

parameters.name: Actor

parameters.description: Global free-text filter: keep only rows whose actor or first target (UPN / app / object name) contains this value. Empty = no filter.

parameters.description: Global free-text filter on the first target display name (application / service principal / object). Empty = no filter.

content.json:
## 🧩 Filters & scope

---

Tune every tile from the pills above without editing KQL. An audit event records an **administrative action, not intent** — always corroborate with sign-in, risk, Graph and incident evidence (see the **Attack Paths** and **Readiness** tabs).

| Filter | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Time Range** | Window applied to all tiles via `{TimeRange}`. | Last 7 days |
| **Queue Priority** | Minimum severity band shown in the SOC priority queue. | All |
| **Result** | Keep only `success` or `failure` audit records. | All |
| **Category (Include)** | Scope to selected `Category` values (RoleManagement, ApplicationManagement, Policy, …). | *(all)* |
| **Logged By Service (Include)** | Scope to selected `LoggedByService` values (Core Directory, PIM, Conditional Access, …). | *(all)* |
| **Excluded Actors** | Comma-separated actor UPNs / app names removed from every tile. | *(empty)* |
| **Actor / Target (global)** | Free-text: keep rows whose actor or first target contains this value (applies to every tile). | *(empty)* |
| **Application / object (global)** | Free-text on the first target display name (app / SP / object). | *(empty)* |
| **Actor IP (global)** | Prefix match on the initiating actor IP (`InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress`). | *(empty)* |
| **Break-glass accounts** | Comma-separated emergency-access UPNs. The Overview **Break-glass monitor** flags ANY audit action by these accounts. | *(empty)* |

## 📊 Identity control-plane overview
---
Consequential change volume and where exposure concentrates. Counts are labelled by change type and are **not** summed into one score. **Top Risks** blends operation, privilege, actor (IdentityInfo), target, timing and self-assignment signals — transparent and for ranking only.

content.title: 🚨 Break-glass account monitor (ANY action = investigate)

content.query:
let _ExRaw = '{ExcludedActors}';
let _Ex = iif(_ExRaw == '', dynamic([]), todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExRaw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _Cats = dynamic([{Category}]);
let _Svcs = dynamic([{LoggedByService}]);
let AuditLogs = AuditLogs
    | where array_length(_Cats) == 0 or Category in~ (_Cats)
    | where array_length(_Svcs) == 0 or LoggedByService in~ (_Svcs)
    | where '{Result}' == 'All' or Result =~ '{Result}'
    | extend _ActorForExcl = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)))
    | where array_length(_Ex) == 0 or _ActorForExcl !in~ (_Ex)
    | extend _ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), _Target0 = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)), _Target0Upn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | where '{Actor}' == '' or _ActorForExcl contains tolower('{Actor}') or _Target0 contains tolower('{Actor}') or _Target0Upn contains tolower('{Actor}')
    | where '{AppFilter}' == '' or _Target0 contains tolower('{AppFilter}')
    | where '{IPFilter}' == '' or _ActorIP startswith '{IPFilter}';
let GARoles = dynamic(["Global Administrator","Privileged Role Administrator","Security Administrator","Application Administrator","Cloud Application Administrator","Conditional Access Administrator","User Administrator","Authentication Administrator","Hybrid Identity Administrator","Domain Name Administrator","Exchange Administrator","SharePoint Administrator"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Result =~ 'success'
| extend Activity = coalesce(ActivityDisplayName, OperationName)
| extend Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| summarize
    NewPrivRole = countif(Activity in~ ('Add member to role','Add eligible member to role') and Role in~ (GARoles)),
    NewAppCreds = countif(Activity in~ ('Add service principal credentials','Update application - Certificates and secrets management')),
    NewConsent = countif(Activity in~ ('Consent to application')),
    NewGrants = countif(Activity in~ ('Add delegated permission grant','Add app role assignment to service principal')),
    CAChanges = countif(Activity has 'conditional access'),
    SecDefaults = countif(Activity has 'security default'),
    Federation = countif(Activity has_any ('federation','domain authentication'))
| project Metric = pack_array('New privileged-role grants','New app credentials','New consent','New permission grants','CA changes','Security-default changes','Federation/domain changes'),
          Value  = pack_array(NewPrivRole, NewAppCreds, NewConsent, NewGrants, CAChanges, SecDefaults, Federation)
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(long)

let _ExRaw = '{ExcludedActors}';
let _Ex = iif(_ExRaw == '', dynamic([]), todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExRaw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _Cats = dynamic([{Category}]);
let _Svcs = dynamic([{LoggedByService}]);
let AuditLogs = AuditLogs
    | where array_length(_Cats) == 0 or Category in~ (_Cats)
    | where array_length(_Svcs) == 0 or LoggedByService in~ (_Svcs)
    | where '{Result}' == 'All' or Result =~ '{Result}'
    | extend _ActorForExcl = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)))
    | where array_length(_Ex) == 0 or _ActorForExcl !in~ (_Ex)
    | extend _ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), _Target0 = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)), _Target0Upn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | where '{Actor}' == '' or _ActorForExcl contains tolower('{Actor}') or _Target0 contains tolower('{Actor}') or _Target0Upn contains tolower('{Actor}')
    | where '{AppFilter}' == '' or _Target0 contains tolower('{AppFilter}')
    | where '{IPFilter}' == '' or _ActorIP startswith '{IPFilter}';
let Priv = IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles, BlastRadius, RiskLevel) by AccountObjectId;
let CriticalOps = dynamic(["Set federation settings on domain","Set domain authentication","Update security defaults","Delete conditional access policy","Update conditional access policy","Add conditional access policy"]);
let HighOps = dynamic(["Add member to role","Add eligible member to role","Add app role assignment to service principal","Add delegated permission grant","Add service principal credentials","Update application - Certificates and secrets management","Consent to application","Reset password","Admin registered security info","Add owner to service principal","Add owner to application"]);
let GARoles = dynamic(["Global Administrator","Privileged Role Administrator","Security Administrator","Application Administrator","Cloud Application Administrator","Conditional Access Administrator","User Administrator","Authentication Administrator","Hybrid Identity Administrator","Domain Name Administrator"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Result =~ 'success'
| extend Activity = coalesce(ActivityDisplayName, OperationName)
| where Activity in~ (CriticalOps) or Activity in~ (HighOps)
| extend ActorId = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id), Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName), Identity)
| extend ActorType = case(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)), 'ServicePrincipal', isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)), 'User', 'System')
| extend TargetName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName), TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName), TgtIds = tostring(TargetResources)
| extend Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName), ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend HourUtc = datetime_part('hour', TimeGenerated)
| extend IsOffHours = HourUtc < 6 or HourUtc > 20
| extend IsGATarget = Activity has 'role' and Role in~ (GARoles)
| extend IsExternalTarget = TargetUpn has '#EXT#'
| extend IsSelf = isnotempty(ActorId) and TgtIds has ActorId
| join kind=leftouter Priv on $left.ActorId == $right.AccountObjectId
| extend OpRisk = toint(case(Activity in~ (CriticalOps), 40, Activity in~ (HighOps), 30, 10))
| extend Score = OpRisk + toint(iff(IsGATarget, 30, 0)) + toint(iff(ActorType == 'ServicePrincipal', 20, 0)) + toint(iff(tolower(tostring(RiskLevel)) == 'high', 15, 0)) + toint(iff(IsExternalTarget, 20, 0)) + toint(iff(IsSelf, 25, 0)) + toint(iff(IsOffHours, 10, 0))
| extend Reasons = strcat(Activity, iff(IsGATarget, ' • privileged-role target', ''), iff(IsSelf, ' • self-assignment', ''), iff(IsExternalTarget, ' • external target', ''), iff(ActorType == 'ServicePrincipal', ' • app-initiated', ''), iff(tolower(tostring(RiskLevel)) == 'high', ' • risky actor', ''), iff(IsOffHours, ' • off-hours', ''))
| extend Severity = case(Score >= 90, '🔴 Critical', Score >= 60, '🟠 High', Score >= 30, '🟡 Medium', '⚪ Info')
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Score, Activity, Actor, ActorType, Target = coalesce(TargetUpn, TargetName), Role, ActorIP, Reasons, CorrelationId
| order by Score desc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
